name: farside-research
description: Run cited deep research and ask questions of the finished report, with every claim linked to its source passage.

interface.longDescription:
Farside runs deep research on a question you give it. It plans searches, reads and grades sources, and writes a report where every claim links to the passage that supports it.

From ChatGPT you can estimate a run before starting it, start Lite, Standard or Deep research, check progress, search a run's graded sources by quality or domain, ask follow-up questions answered only from that run's evidence, and build a multi-document dossier. Saved research workflows can be listed, started and approved from the chat too.

Sign-in uses your Farside account. On the approval screen you pick the workspace, read or run access, and a monthly credit cap for the connection. Research runs, follow-up questions and dossiers use credits from that workspace; estimates, reads and source search do not.
capabilities: Ask questions of a finished report
defaultPrompt: Research how heat pumps perform in very cold climates, with sources.
What does my latest research run say about costs? Cite the passages.
How much would a Standard research run on this question cost?

positive.prompt: How much would a Lite Farside research run cost on whether four-day work weeks raise productivity?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the estimated credits, expected source count and duration for a Lite run without starting anything or spending credits.

positive.prompt: Use Farside to run Lite research on whether four-day work weeks raise productivity.
positive.expected_behavior: Starts a Lite run in the connected workspace and returns its run id and status. Credits are reserved from the workspace balance.

positive.prompt: What research runs do I have in Farside, and is the four-day week one finished?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the workspace's runs and reports the status of the matching run, including the report summary once it is complete.

positive.prompt: Show the highest quality sources from my four-day work week research.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns that run's sources filtered to high quality, each with its title, domain, grade and link.

positive.prompt: According to my four-day work week research, what happened to productivity in the largest trial? Cite the passage.
positive.expected_behavior: Answers only from that run's evidence and cites the supporting passages; says so if the run does not cover it.

negative.prompt: Use Farside to send $50 to my colleague.
Delete all of my Farside research runs.

negative.description: Another workspace's data is not accessible
negative.prompt: Show me the research runs from a different company's Farside workspace.

review.commerce_description: Farside does not sell products or take payments inside ChatGPT. Research uses credits already in the user's Farside workspace.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: estimate, start and track cited research runs, search graded sources, ask grounded follow-ups, build dossiers, and run saved research workflows.
